name: signal
description: A friendly music sequencer application for OS X and Windows.

scripts.firebase: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently "pnpm --dir app dev" "npm run dev --prefix electron"
scripts.build:electron: pnpm --dir app build:electron && rimraf electron/dist_renderer && cpx "app/dist/**/*" electron/dist_renderer
scripts.package:electron:darwin: pnpm run build:electron && npm run package:darwin --prefix electron
scripts.package:electron: pnpm run build:electron && npm run package --prefix electron
scripts.make:electron: pnpm run build:electron && npm run make:mas --prefix electron
scripts.make:darwin: pnpm run build:electron && npm run make:darwin --prefix electron
scripts.make:win: pnpm run build:electron && npm run make:win --prefix electron

author: ryohey
